entries.reason: Independent sky weather and cloud travel use injected integer simulation duration and analytical transition integration.
entries.time_source: Caller-supplied eve::Duration; checked accumulated integer nanoseconds.
entries.rng_stream: No RNG in this deterministic interpolation layer.
entries.determinism: Equal commands at equal simulation times preserve weather and cloud travel across frame subdivision. Authored cloud time derives from the same accumulated timeline, including explicit source speed/time/wind multipliers; only normalized phase is converted to GPU float.
entries.tolerance: 1e-9 in ordinary-duration CPU contract tests; no cross-platform bitwise claim.

module_interface.capability_in: Caller injects Duration and typed weather commands; SkyRuntime preparation receives the existing Graphics provider and copied settings.
module_interface.capability_out: Validated SkyTimeline and SkySolarOrbit values; owning SkyRuntime publishes the same evaluated solar light to main-view and capture contributors.
module_interface.ecs_links: None; timeline retains only owned values.
module_interface.script_bindings: DayNight.prepareSky(gfx, profileJson) returns an owned SkyRuntime Result; attach/detach/advanceSeconds/frame use common Result projection and VM-owned lifetime.
module_interface.tool_protocol: SkyProfile decodes eve.sky-profile versions 1 through 6. Version 6 selects procedural-v1 via null wispsAsset and an explicit uint32 proceduralSeed; a supplied path must load successfully. Version 3 references an optional graphics-owned wisps asset loaded during preparation; no new tool endpoint.
module_interface.hard_dependencies: Common Result/Duration and daynight's already-declared graphics dependency; public runtime header uses forward declarations and Pimpl.
module_interface.connection: One simulation owner; frequent direct typed updates and copied read projections. No hot-path registry.

entries.reason: Authored atmospheric profiles validate completely before GPU preparation or runtime publication.
entries.schema: eve.sky-profile; explicit atmosphere mode with complete clock, weather, sun and optical parameters.
entries.version: Integer version 6 adds proceduralSeed and null wispsAsset selection; version 5 adds directional fog elevation range; version 4 adds cloudMotion controls (phase, speed, timeScale, windMultiplier). Version 3 adds wisps; version 2 adds background height fog. Not a simulation save.
entries.migration: Version 1 disables height fog; versions 1/2 disable wisps; versions 1/2/3 explicitly freeze cloud motion with speed zero. Versions 1 through 4 disable directional fog elevation fading; version 5 requires its explicit elevation range. Unsupported versions and modes fail.
entries.unknown_fields: Reject unknown or missing fields at every object level, wrong types, vector dimensions and nonfinite/out-of-range numbers.
entries.restore_atomicity: Decode creates an immutable candidate without provider calls; existing profiles and runtimes are never mutated on import failure.
